label: Update #18
title: Update #18: Vynthra Rework, Spectator Tools, Balance and More

entries.subject: Asterion
entries.note: Asterions are very powerful once you have a few (inherently making them an amazing Replicate target). We love how they work: dodging the orb and hitting enemies with it should feel meaningful, so we're aiming at the cooldown and slight cost increase for nerfs this week.

lines.text: Fireball more reliably hits fast-moving units (like units using Dash)

entries.subject: Dreadnought

lines.text: AA turret no longer increases move speed
Bomb module now gives +50 move speed

entries.note: 750 MS was unintended. We swapped MS from AA Turret to Bomb Module because it better fits its identity especially when attempting bombardment during fights. AA Turret feels good at what it does, so no compensatory buff this week, but we'll keep an eye on it.

lines.text: Health while building 1300 to 1000, construction phase now matches the completed Terror Tank

entries.subject: Storm Bringer
entries.note:
Starting Energy buffed but stays below the thresh-hold to cast Tempest, we want for conduits and its energy upgrade to remain interesting options to accelerate the unit to its peak strength (Tempest).

Added slow and range to its basic attack to help its utility and safety outside of casting its ability, at 75% slow the Storm Bringer should become a good catching tool against valuable targets.

entries.subject: Titan
entries.note: Anti-Medium is now very prevalent in the meta, and Protectorate had too many medium units. Visually, the Titan looks chunky enough to accept the 'heavy' tag since its model re-work. In the mirror match-up (PvP) it opens up for Sentinels to push Titan players to diversify.

entries.subject: Lasher
entries.note: Because Lashers are a core unit that players can mass, small changes can have a big impact. We will monitor, and if we need to push them further it'll continue to be very gradual.

entries.subject: Orbital Laser
entries.note: It's very strong but more importantly it lasted too long, the ability is at its strongest and most fun in its early life, but continuing to manage or avoid it can begin feel like a chore for both players. We will monitor it; if further nerfs are needed, duration remains a good candidate.

entries.subject: Echo
entries.note: A better fit visually, and Xol already has a lot of Medium units.

entries.subject: Defiant
entries.note: Both the Xyther and Defiant (frontline Xol units) got countered by the same units. This change should increase army diversity and interaction on both ends.

entries.subject: Harvester
entries.note: A QoL change to make it easier to cast effectively.

entries.subject: Overclock
entries.note: Overclock is very prominent, so reducing its damage bonus from 35% to 25% is effectively an army-wide nerf, as Synapses are often a must-have support unit for sustain and Overclock. The move speed change is a smaller nerf that disproportionately affects faster Xol units. It also continues our shift toward flat bonuses in certain areas to prevent percentage-based bonuses from stacking out of control.

lines.text: Now needs any T1 production building instead of the Power Core

entries.subject: Spectron

lines.text: Molten form shot now fades after 4s instead of 5s when it does not hit

entries.note: Should help some with disengaging against it. We'll continue to keep an eye on it.

entries.subject: Synapse
entries.note:
Beautiful as their tentacles are, large numbers of Synapses flying over Xol armies can create visual clutter. Given their supportive role, we want players to feel less need to mass them while preserving their place as a core Xol unit.

Each heal restores roughly the same total health, but over a longer duration, reducing its ability to keep individual units alive under fire while preserving strong out-of-combat recovery. Faster friendly slaps and longer-lasting heals allow a single Synapse to keep more units actively healing.

The aim is for fewer Synapses to cover an army's healing needs, making additional Synapses less valuable for healing alone. Note also that the Overclock nerf affects the other side of their value proposition.

entries.subject: Replicate

lines.text: No longer costs 1 base Power per unit replicated

entries.note:
Nerfing replicate is a faction-wide nerf. We want to keep interactions with mercs strong (they're already priced higher).

Some Mercs like the aforementioned Asterion are natural synergy fits, but synergies are good! We are not considering independently pricing per unit outside of the current formula at the moment.

lines.text: Lifesteal no longer works on buildings
Workers, Legion Harvesters, Kingdom Cultists and Valkaru Grabbers can now stack their heals and repairs on one target instead of spreading out
